headlines.title: Brent Crashes 7% on Iran Peace Hopes Despite Fresh Saudi Pipeline Attack
headlines.summary: Another round of unconfirmed reports about a potential U.S.-Iran diplomatic breakthrough sent fresh optimism rippling through oil markets on Monday, after Al Arabiya claimed that a Qatari-Pakistani mediation proposal had revived serious negotiations over Tehran's nuclear program.
